# brew: switch from kamilsk/tap to octolab/tap

Point the Brewfile at the author's tap under the OctoLab organisation instead of the personal one. **Motivation:** "there is only one entry point now" — the formulae (`godownloader`, `goimports`, `golangci-lint`, `maintainer`, later `sparkle`) had moved to `octolab/homebrew-tap`, and keeping two taps meant duplicate installs and name clashes.
